THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 33
My No.: KDS/MDB/4/2/1/64/06.File No. Ministry of Land: 13J/95/FR/178.

I, Nuwan Chandana Hemakumara, Divisional Secretary, Medadumbara in Kandy District, have acquired the land described in the following schedule under Section 33 of the Land Acquisition Act, (Chapter 460) for Knuckles Reserve. As the ownership of the said land cannot be proved, I hereby inform that the nominal compensation entitled to it, as per the Acquisition Act has been credited to the case number shown in the schedule of the District Court, Theldeniya.
